verdict.rationale: Wrike is a work-management SaaS. Having an agent verify its own code implementation by navigating an app and capturing before-and-after screenshots is a coding or browser-automation agent capability, which falls outside this product category. Wrike's agents (triage, risk assessment, task execution) and its MCP connectivity do not include any app-navigation or screenshot verification mode, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
